name: reservation-espace
description: Application de Réservation d'Espace — PWA de réservation de postes, salles et espaces de coworking

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emu,web -c blue,green "npm:emulators" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
scripts.emulators:clean: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start
scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run seed && vitest run --project api"
